Definition: from G2556 and the base of G2041; a wrong-doer, i.e. criminal:--evil-doer, malefactor.
BiblicalUsage: Kakourgos is the criminal, the wrong-doer — the name given to the two men crucified beside Jesus. Two malefactors were led with Him to be put to death, and one of them railed on Him; and Paul says he suffers trouble as an evildoer, even unto bonds, but the word of God is not bound.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the malefactors are the gospel in miniature: one railed and one repented, and the dying thief who asked to be remembered went to Paradise that day. No one is too far gone to ask, and no one is so far gone that asking is too late.
